# Credits and data sources

IR Builder is licensed under GPL-3.0.

The controller graphics and vendored infrared signal implementation originate from Flipper Devices firmware 1.4.3, licensed under GPL-3.0. Their detailed notices are in the assets and vendor directories.

The bundled TV builder library begins with the Universal TV library shipped on the tested Momentum mntm-012 installation. Its additional candidates were deterministically deduplicated from TV remotes in the Lucaslhm Flipper-IRDB project and a user-tested Beko remote. Flipper-IRDB is distributed under CC0-1.0.

- Flipper firmware: https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware
- Momentum firmware: https://github.com/Next-Flip/Momentum-Firmware
- Flipper-IRDB: https://github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB

No TV manufacturer artwork, logos, product photographs, or serial numbers are included.
